question_en:
The attachment is the first complete folio-side image of a Western manuscript from the digital manuscript catalog of a public museum. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which institution holds this manuscript? Please provide the shelf mark and title.
2. In the complete manuscript index of this institution, how many manuscripts have an origin field explicitly containing "Italy" and a catalog date overlapping with 1401–1500? Count each shelf mark only once.
3. Review the first complete folio-side image on the detail page of each candidate manuscript. Which manuscripts have a decorative initial letter spanning at least four lines of main text? Please provide the shelf marks and titles of all matching manuscripts.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the holding institution, shelf mark, and title in text. For Question 2, provide the deduplicated total number of manuscripts in text. For Question 3, list the shelf marks and titles of all matching manuscripts in a table.
